title: A Fraudulent Election in North Carolina

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: For months, allegations of fraud have swirled around a congressional race in North Carolina's
sentences.zh: 几个月来，关于北卡罗来纳州

sentences.en: 9th District.
sentences.zh: 第九选区的一场国会竞选，欺诈指控一直甚嚣尘上。

sentences.en: But the Republican at the center of the controversy has held on.
sentences.zh: 但处于争议中心的共和党人却一直坚持着。

sentences.en: Why, he's finally giving up.
sentences.zh: 怎么，他终于要放弃了。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, February 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月27日，星期三。

sentences.en: As directed by law, the clerk of the House has prepared the official role of the representatives-elect.
sentences.zh: 根据法律规定，众议院书记官已准备好当选代表的正式名册。

sentences.en: So it's January 3rd, and hundreds and hundreds of members of Congress are coming to Capitol Hill to be sworn in for the new Congress after a really bruising midterm election.
sentences.zh: 现在是1月3日，在经历了一场极其激烈的期中选举后，数百名国会议员来到国会山，准备宣誓就职新一届国会。

sentences.en: Certificates of election, 434 seats in the 116th Congress have been received by the clerk of the
sentences.zh: 众议院书记官已收到第116届国会434个席位的

sentences.en: House.
sentences.zh: 当选证书。

sentences.en: But as everyone shows up on Capitol Hill, there's one seat everyone knows is going to remain empty.
sentences.zh: 但当所有人出现在国会山时，有一个席位大家都知道将保持空缺。

sentences.en: The clerk has not received a certificate of election for the 9th District of the state of North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 书记官尚未收到北卡罗来纳州第九选区的当选证书。

sentences.en: And that's the House seat from North Carolina's 9th District.
sentences.zh: 那就是北卡罗来纳州第九选区的众议院席位。

sentences.en: Alan Blinder covers the American South for The Times.
sentences.zh: 艾伦·布林德为《时报》报道美国南部新闻。

sentences.en: The story of that seat and why it was empty on January 3rd is this extraordinary tale of election fraud, the scale of which we've not really seen very often in American politics.
sentences.zh: 关于那个席位以及它为何在1月3日空缺的故事，是一个非同寻常的选举欺诈故事，其规模在美式政治中并不多见。

sentences.en: So, Alan, take us back to when this story starts.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾伦，带我们回到这个故事开始的时候。

sentences.en: Who was supposed to fill that seat in North Carolina?
sentences.zh: 谁本应填补北卡罗来纳州的那个席位？

sentences.en: Well, that depends on who you ask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那取决于你问谁。

sentences.en: If you ask the Republicans, Mark Harris was destined for that seat in Congress.
sentences.zh: 如果你问共和党人，马克·哈里斯注定要坐上那个国会席位。

sentences.en: And I want you to know that this evening that this is a journey that really has been two years in the making.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们知道，今晚这个旅程确实是历经两年才走到这一步的。

sentences.en: But I'm glad to report tonight it's just getting started.
sentences.zh: 但我很高兴今晚能报告说，这仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: Mark Harris on election night thinks that he has managed to pull off a victory against Dan
sentences.zh: 选举之夜，马克·哈里斯认为他已经成功击败了丹·

sentences.en: McCready, who was one of the most prized Democratic candidates of last year.
sentences.zh: 麦克雷迪，后者是去年最受推崇的民主党候选人之一。

sentences.en: He thought he had won the election by about 905 votes.
sentences.zh: 他以为自己以大约905票的优势赢得了选举。

sentences.en: I'm going to Washington to be your voice in the 9th
sentences.zh: 我要去华盛顿，成为你们在第九

sentences.en: Congressional District.
sentences.zh: 国会选区的代言人。

sentences.en: So, Mark Harris goes on to Washington, goes to new member orientation.
sentences.zh: 于是，马克·哈里斯前往华盛顿，参加新议员培训。

sentences.en: But back in North Carolina, people are starting to think that some of the numbers in his election look a little fishy.
sentences.zh: 但在北卡罗来纳州，人们开始觉得他选举中的一些数字看起来有点可疑。

sentences.en: And people just started to wonder, is there something that went wrong in this campaign that let Mark Harris win?
sentences.zh: 人们开始怀疑，这场竞选中是否出了什么问题，才让马克·哈里斯获胜？

sentences.en: Now at 10, an election controversy.
sentences.zh: 现在是10点，一场选举争议。

sentences.en: Allegations of fraud in one of the country's tightest races.
sentences.zh: 全国最胶着的选区之一出现了欺诈指控。

sentences.en: And what exactly seemed off about his election?
sentences.zh: 他的选举到底哪里看起来不对劲？

sentences.en: What was it that was so fishy?
sentences.zh: 到底是什么地方那么可疑？

sentences.en: Frankly, a lot of things seemed off.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，很多地方都不对劲。

sentences.en: There was a concern about the number of absentee ballots, especially in one county.
sentences.zh: 人们对缺席选票的数量感到担忧，特别是在一个县。

sentences.en: When Mark Harris declared victory, he sang Blayden County's praises.
sentences.zh: 当马克·哈里斯宣布获胜时，他大肆赞扬了布莱登县。

sentences.en: Thank God for Blayden and Union County.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝保佑布莱登县和联合县。

sentences.en: One month later, no one is laughing or applauding as state investigators look into the results of the
sentences.zh: 一个月后，当州调查人员调查

sentences.en: 9th District election.
sentences.zh: 第九选区选举结果时，没人再笑得出来或鼓掌了。

sentences.en: Mark Harris won something like 60-some-odd percent of absentee ballots in Blayden County.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯在布莱登县赢得了大约60%多的缺席选票。

sentences.en: And what was unusual about that is Republicans accounted for less than 20 percent of the absentee ballots.
sentences.zh: 不同寻常的是，共和党人仅占缺席选票总数的不到20%。

sentences.en: So he won well more than half, while registered Republicans accounted for less than a fifth of those ballots.
sentences.zh: 所以他赢得了超过一半的选票，而注册共和党人仅占这些选票的不到五分之一。

sentences.en: And that math doesn't quite make any sense because it would mean he was winning non-Republican absentee ballots, which is surprising.
sentences.zh: 这种数学逻辑完全说不通，因为这意味着他赢得了非共和党人的缺席选票，这令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Something smelled really wrong to a lot of people looking at those numbers.
sentences.zh: 很多看到这些数字的人都觉得事情很不对劲。

sentences.en: And how does Mark Harris explain all of this after the election?
sentences.zh: 那么马克·哈里斯在选举后是如何解释这一切的呢？

sentences.en: He says he won at Fair and Swear.
sentences.zh: 他说他赢得光明正大。

sentences.en: He says he ran an aggressive campaign.
sentences.zh: 他说他进行了一场积极的竞选活动。

sentences.en: That's what Republicans say.
sentences.zh: 共和党人就是这么说的。

sentences.en: They say that they made a really concerted push.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们进行了非常协调一致的推动。

sentences.en: They knew it would be a tight race, and they pulled out all the stops and were looking for votes wherever they could find them.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这将是一场势均力敌的比赛，所以他们竭尽全力，寻找任何能找到的选票。

sentences.en: Well, the state isn't so sure that Mark Harris is the clear winner, and they start digging into what happened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，州政府不太确定马克·哈里斯是明确的赢家，于是开始深入调查发生了什么。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, in North Carolina, a bunch of us reporters are driving around looking for anything we can find about what might have happened.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在北卡罗来纳州，我们一群记者四处奔走，寻找任何可能发生过什么的线索。

sentences.en: We're knocking on doors.
sentences.zh: 我们挨家挨户敲门。

sentences.en: We're asking people, have you ever met anyone who came to collect your ballot, for example?
sentences.zh: 我们问人们，比如，你有没有见过有人来收集你的选票？

sentences.en: And it doesn't take long before we start to learn about a man named McCray Dallas.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我们就开始了解到一个叫麦克雷·达拉斯的人。

sentences.en: We're learning more about the man at the center of the District 9 election fraud investigation and how he operates.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进一步了解这位处于第九选区选举欺诈调查中心的人物，以及他的运作方式。

sentences.en: McCray Dallas is a longtime political operative in Blayden County.
sentences.zh: 麦克雷·达拉斯是布莱登县的一名资深政治操盘手。

sentences.en: He's in his 60s now.
sentences.zh: 他现在60多岁了。

sentences.en: This is McCray Dallas.
sentences.zh: 这就是麦克雷·达拉斯。

sentences.en: Here's a picture of him on the left.
sentences.zh: 这是他左边的照片。

sentences.en: He's rail thin.
sentences.zh: 他瘦骨嶙峋。

sentences.en: He's pretty slight in stature.
sentences.zh: 身材相当瘦小。

sentences.en: Smokes a lot of cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 烟不离手。

sentences.en: Mark Harris is not the only candidate that Dallas is connected to.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯并不是与达拉斯有联系的唯一候选人。

sentences.en: He was known as the elections guru, if you will, in Blayden County.
sentences.zh: 他被誉为布莱登县的“选举大师”。

sentences.en: He actually got a certificate for that once.
sentences.zh: 他甚至曾因此获得过证书。

sentences.en: A certificate saying that he's essentially the guy who knows the system beSt.
sentences.zh: 那张证书基本上证明他是最了解这套系统的人。

sentences.en: He's the guy who knows where to find votes in Blayden County.
sentences.zh: 他是那个知道在布莱登县哪里能找到选票的人。

sentences.en: And he had a long track record of working with Republicans and Democrats on their elections and helping people really scrounge up absentee votes to come up with winning margins.
sentences.zh: 他有与共和党人和民主党人合作选举的长期记录，并帮助人们四处搜罗缺席选票，以获得获胜优势。

sentences.en: Mr. Dallas is accused of wrongdoing, basically using workers to forge signatures and collect ballots, which you can't even do in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯先生被指控有不当行为，主要是利用工作人员伪造签名和收集选票，这在北卡罗来纳州甚至是不允许的。

sentences.en: As reporters are digging into McCray Dallas's past, we realize very quickly that he's not just your run-of-the-mill political operative.
sentences.zh: 随着记者们深入挖掘麦克雷·达拉斯的过去，我们很快意识到他不仅仅是一个普通的政治操盘手。

sentences.en: Dallas was part of the 2014 McVicar campaign, but was paid in a way that would not show up on campaign finance reports.
sentences.zh: 达拉斯参与了2014年的麦克维卡竞选，但他的报酬支付方式使其不会出现在竞选财务报告中。

sentences.en: He's a guy with felony convictions for fraud and perjury.
sentences.zh: 他是一个有欺诈和伪证重罪前科的人。

sentences.en: In another document from the suit, Dallas himself confirms he worked for the 2014 campaign to get out the vote.
sentences.zh: 在诉讼的另一份文件中，达拉斯本人证实他曾为2014年的竞选工作以争取选票。

sentences.en: He's a guy who's been investigated in the past for his political work, but was never prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 他过去曾因政治工作受到调查，但从未被起诉。

sentences.en: And it was not long after that, that Mark Harris hired McCray Dallas and said, I want you to help me find absentee voters in Blayden County and help me win an election next year.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，马克·哈里斯就雇用了麦克雷·达拉斯，并说：“我希望你帮我在布莱登县找到缺席选民，帮我赢得明年的选举。”

sentences.en: At that point, we started to put the pieces together and we started to realize that there was probably something very wrong that had happened in Blayden County.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我们开始拼凑线索，并意识到布莱登县可能发生了非常严重的问题。

sentences.en: But we didn't know exactly what had happened until last week.
sentences.zh: 但直到上周，我们才知道到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获得30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: So last week, I went up to North Carolina for a hearing where the state was going to start showing its evidence of what it found during this investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以上周，我去了北卡罗来纳州参加一场听证会，州政府将在会上开始展示其在调查中发现的证据。

sentences.en: Start with by thanking the
sentences.zh: 首先感谢

sentences.en: North Carolina State Bar for allowing us to use their ability to conduct this hearing.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州律师协会允许我们使用他们的设施进行此次听证会。

sentences.en: So the hearing room's packed on Monday morning.
sentences.zh: 周一早上，听证室挤满了人。

sentences.en: This courtroom where lawyers usually go when they're in trouble, but it was one of the bigger courtrooms in Raleigh.
sentences.zh: 这个法庭通常是律师遇到麻烦时去的地方，但它是罗利较大的法庭之一。

sentences.en: So we all crowd in there waiting to hear for the first time what on earth the state has come up with.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都挤在那里，等着第一次听到州政府到底查出了什么。

sentences.en: By statute to the opening of each meeting, we must read a conflict of interest statement and check to see if any members...
sentences.zh: 根据法规，在每次会议开始时，我们必须宣读利益冲突声明，并检查是否有成员……

sentences.en: Mark Harris himself is in the courtroom sitting among his lawyers.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯本人坐在他的律师中间。

sentences.en: And the first person to speak is the executive director of the elections board.
sentences.zh: 第一个发言的是选举委员会的执行主任。

sentences.en: We believe the evidence that we will provide today will show that a coordinated, unlawful, and substantially resourced absentee ballot scheme operated during the 2018 general
sentences.zh: 我们相信今天提供的证据将表明，在2018年大选期间，存在一个协调一致、非法且资源充足的缺席选票计划……

sentences.en: election...
sentences.zh: 选举……

sentences.en: And she immediately says that investigators had found an unlawful and coordinated effort to try to influence absentee voting.
sentences.zh: 她立即表示，调查人员发现了一项非法且协调一致的企图，旨在影响缺席投票。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Witnesses, your staff.
sentences.zh: 证人，你的工作人员。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chair.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生。

sentences.en: Good morning,
sentences.zh: 早上好，

sentences.en: Ms. Britt.
sentences.zh: 布里特女士。

sentences.en: One of the state's star witnesses, a woman named Lisa Britt, takes the stand.
sentences.zh: 州政府的明星证人之一，一位名叫丽莎·布里特的女士，走上证人席。

sentences.en: And Lisa Britt is a stepdaughter of McRae Dallas, and she worked for him during the 2018 campaign.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·布里特是麦克雷·达拉斯的继女，她在2018年竞选期间为他工作。

sentences.en: Did Mr. Dallas ask you to go out and request absentee ballots from potential voters?
sentences.zh: 达拉斯先生是否要求你出去向潜在选民索取缺席选票？

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And she starts to describe how McRae Dallas' operation worked.
sentences.zh: 她开始描述麦克雷·达拉斯的运作方式。

sentences.en: Blayden County is a poor county.
sentences.zh: 布莱登县是一个贫困县。

sentences.en: So we were actually going out with the absentee request forms to give people the opportunity so everybody would have the opportunity to vote.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上是带着缺席选票申请表出去，给人们机会，让每个人都有机会投票。

sentences.en: It just becomes this catalog of crime.
sentences.zh: 这简直成了一份犯罪目录。

sentences.en: On some, I think it may have been people who had voted in previous elections or whatever, so we would fill out the top part.
sentences.zh: 在一些选票上，我想可能是那些在之前选举中投过票的人，我们会填好上半部分。

sentences.en: They would collect absentee ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们会收集缺席选票。

sentences.en: They would fill in absentee ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们会填写缺席选票。

sentences.en: They would forge signatures as witnesses for absentee ballots.
sentences.zh: 他们会伪造签名作为缺席选票的见证人。

sentences.en: Did he provide you with instructions about not admitting to collecting ballots?
sentences.zh: 他是否指示你不要承认收集选票？

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: And the operation was designed to make sure Mark Harris had enough absentee votes to win the election.
sentences.zh: 这项行动旨在确保马克·哈里斯有足够的缺席选票来赢得选举。

sentences.en: It was an effort that was rooted in fraud, rooted in misconduct, and it was supposed to put Mark Harris over the top.
sentences.zh: 这是一项根植于欺诈、根植于不当行为的努力，旨在让马克·哈里斯胜出。

sentences.en: Now, I would excuse.
sentences.zh: 现在，我请求退席。

sentences.en: Thank you, sir.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，先生。

sentences.en: Mrs. Britt.
sentences.zh: 布里特夫人。

sentences.en: Kelly Hendricks.
sentences.zh: 凯利·亨德里克斯。

sentences.en: So as the hearing goes on, we hear from more and more witnesses.
sentences.zh: 随着听证会的进行，我们听到了越来越多的证词。

sentences.en: We hear from another woman who worked for McRae Dallas.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了另一位为麦克雷·达拉斯工作的女性的证词。

sentences.en: We hear from vocal elections officials.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了选举官员的发言。

sentences.en: Could you state your name, please?
sentences.zh: 请报上你的名字好吗？

sentences.en: Sandra Bell.
sentences.zh: 桑德拉·贝尔。

sentences.en: Mrs. Dell.
sentences.zh: 戴尔夫人。

sentences.en: We hear from a consultant for Mark Harris.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了马克·哈里斯的一位顾问的证词。

sentences.en: Mrs. Strack, are you ready for your next witness, please?
sentences.zh: 斯特拉克夫人，你准备好迎接下一位证人了吗？

sentences.en: But then there's a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 但随后出现了一个大惊喜。

sentences.en: ...to call John Harris.
sentences.zh: ……传唤约翰·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And that's when the state calls Mark Harris's son, John Harris, up to the witness stamp.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，州政府传唤了马克·哈里斯的儿子约翰·哈里斯走上证人席。

sentences.en: You have an attorney here with you, even though you've...
sentences.zh: 你这里有一位律师陪同，尽管你已经……

sentences.en: I do not, but I am wanting to represent myself in this capacity.
sentences.zh: 我没有，但我希望以这种身份代表我自己。

sentences.en: John Harris is a 29-year-old lawyer for the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 约翰·哈里斯是司法部一名29岁的律师。

sentences.en: He's one of the single most self-assured lawyers I think I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是我见过最自信的律师之一。

sentences.en: And he comes up to the witness stand, and he starts to tell a really remarkable and compelling story.
sentences.zh: 他走上证人席，开始讲述一个非常引人注目且令人信服的故事。

sentences.en: I expressed my concerns based on everything that I did know up to that point.
sentences.zh: 我基于当时所知的一切表达了我的担忧。

sentences.en: For weeks and weeks and weeks, Mark Harris had been denying to just about everyone who would listen that he knew of any kind of wrongdoing involving McRae Dallas,
sentences.zh: 数周以来，马克·哈里斯一直在向几乎所有愿意听的人否认他知道任何涉及麦克雷·达拉斯的不当行为，

sentences.en: that he had no reason to be suspicious of him.
sentences.zh: 声称他没有理由怀疑对方。

sentences.en: And he actually admitted that he had been the person responsible for hiring McRae Dallas.
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上承认了自己就是负责聘用麦克雷·达拉斯的人。

sentences.en: But then John Harris gets up on the witness stand, and the state pulls out an email that John Harris sent to his father the day after Mark Harris met with McRae Dallas.
sentences.zh: 但随后约翰·哈里斯走上证人席，州政府拿出了一封约翰·哈里斯在马克·哈里斯与麦克雷·达拉斯会面后第二天发给他父亲的电子邮件。

sentences.en: This is an email that I sent to my father, and I copied my mother.
sentences.zh: 这是一封我发给我父亲的邮件，我抄送给了我母亲。

sentences.en: The email is John Harris, the son, telling his father that McRae Dallas is trouble, that he had concerns about whether his operation was on the up-and-up.
sentences.zh: 这封邮件是儿子约翰·哈里斯告诉他父亲，麦克雷·达拉斯是个麻烦，他担心对方的运作是否正当。

sentences.en: And so that's what this meant to summarize how these numbers seem so off.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么这些数字看起来如此不对劲的总结。

sentences.en: I think we realized we were watching a political collapse happen right in front of us.
sentences.zh: 我想我们意识到我们正在目睹一场政治崩溃在眼前发生。

sentences.en: I just want to say this in closing.
sentences.zh: 最后我只想说这一点。

sentences.en: I love my dad, and I love my mom.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的父亲，也爱我的母亲。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And I think Mark Harris may have realized that too.
sentences.zh: 我想马克·哈里斯可能也意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: I think that they made mistakes in this process, and they certainly did things differently than I would have done them.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们在过程中犯了错误，而且他们所做的事情肯定与我会采取的方式不同。

sentences.en: Mark Harris was crying from where he was watching all of this.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯在观看这一切时流下了眼泪。

sentences.en: I mean, he was weeping as he watched his son testify.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他在看着儿子作证时泪流满面。

sentences.en: And frankly, when I'm coming out of this process, I'm just left thinking that we can all do a lot better than this.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，当我走出这个过程时，我只是觉得我们所有人本可以做得更好。

sentences.en: That's all I have, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我只有这些要说的了。

sentences.en: Would you state your name, please?
sentences.zh: 请报上你的名字好吗？

sentences.en: I'm Mark Harris.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And then Mark Harris himself takes the stand, and his day begins as a disaster, and it gets worse.
sentences.zh: 随后马克·哈里斯本人走上证人席，他的一天以灾难开始，而且变得更糟。

sentences.en: You didn't ask Dallas, are you harvesting ballots?
sentences.zh: 你没有问达拉斯，你是在收集选票吗？

sentences.en: Well, he had made that clear that he was not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他已经明确表示他没有。

sentences.en: He starts telling the elections board about how he had, in fact, hired McRae Dallas, but that he didn't know that McRae Dallas or any of his workers were doing anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 他开始向选举委员会讲述他实际上是如何聘用麦克雷·达拉斯的，但他不知道麦克雷·达拉斯或他的任何工作人员在做任何违法的事情。

sentences.en: Well, I had no reason to hide this email.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有理由隐瞒这封邮件。

sentences.en: In fact, it was my understanding it was going to be produced.
sentences.zh: 事实上，据我理解，它是会被提交的。

sentences.en: Eventually, Harris misleads the board with a few instances of what his critics thought was perjury.
sentences.zh: 最终，哈里斯用几个被批评者认为是伪证的例子误导了委员会。

sentences.en: I did not consider Johns to be a warning that this was a problem and could be a real serious potential problem.
sentences.zh: 我并没有把约翰的话视为这是一个问题，或者可能是一个非常严重的潜在问题的警告。

sentences.en: And the state's bloggers realized that.
sentences.zh: 州政府的博主们意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, it becomes clear that Mark Harris's own bloggers realized that, too.
sentences.zh: 很快，马克·哈里斯自己的博主们也意识到了这一点，这一点变得显而易见。

sentences.en: So, then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么，接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: I would ask for a short recess to have a discussion with the board.
sentences.zh: 我请求短暂休会，以便与委员会进行讨论。

sentences.en: His lawyer calls a recess, and there's a lot of confusion, frankly, in the courtroom over what on earth is happening.
sentences.zh: 他的律师要求休会，坦率地说，法庭内对于到底发生了什么感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: Take our lunch break now, and we'll come back.
sentences.zh: 现在休息吃午饭，我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: We all go to lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们都去吃午饭了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, there's some closed-door negotiating happening.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，有一些闭门谈判正在进行。

sentences.en: We reconvene a little later.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后重新开会。

sentences.en: I'm startled by saying, Dr. Harris, you know you're still under oath, and you're still here to volunteer.
sentences.zh: 我惊讶地说，哈里斯博士，你知道你仍然在宣誓中，你仍然在这里自愿作证。

sentences.en: And Mark Harris comes back out to the witness stand and surprises everyone.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯回到证人席，让所有人都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, I have a statement that I wish to make.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我有一份声明想要发表。

sentences.en: He gets up and talks about how he'd had some medical probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他站起来谈到他遇到了一些健康问题。

sentences.en: On January 18th, I went to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 1月18日，我去了医院。

sentences.en: After battling what we thought was bronchitis, I developed a severe infection that actually caused me to become septic.
sentences.zh: 在与我们认为是支气管炎的疾病抗争后，我出现了严重的感染，实际上导致我患上了败血症。

sentences.en: In the process of that illness, I experienced two strokes, from which I'm still recovering.
sentences.zh: 在那次疾病的过程中，我经历了两次中风，目前仍在恢复中。

sentences.en: Though I thought I was ready to undergo the rigors of this hearing, and I'm getting stronger, I clearly am not.
sentences.zh: 虽然我以为自己已经准备好承受这次听证会的严苛要求，而且我正在变得更强壮，但我显然还没有。

sentences.en: And I struggled this morning with both recall and confusion.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我在记忆力和困惑感方面都感到挣扎。

sentences.en: How he had offered what he called incorrect testimony.
sentences.zh: 他如何提供了他所谓的错误证词。

sentences.en: Through the testimony I've listened to over the past three days, I believe a new election should be called.
sentences.zh: 通过过去三天我所听到的证词，我认为应该举行新的选举。

sentences.en: And then he calls for a new election.
sentences.zh: 然后他呼吁进行新的选举。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's become clear to me that the public's confidence in the ninth district seat general election has been undermined to an extent that a new election is warranted.
sentences.zh: 我已经清楚地认识到，公众对第九选区大选的信心已经受到了损害，以至于有必要进行新的选举。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, that concludes my statement.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，我的声明到此结束。

sentences.en: Mark Harris, with the lead that he has in this race, is suddenly calling for a brand new election.
sentences.zh: 马克·哈里斯在这次竞选中拥有领先优势，却突然呼吁进行一场全新的选举。

sentences.en: Yeah, I send an all-caps email to my editors.
sentences.zh: 是的，我给我的编辑发了一封全大写的邮件。

sentences.en: What did it say?
sentences.zh: 上面写了什么？

sentences.en: I think it was something like, Harris calls for new election.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是类似“哈里斯呼吁进行新选举”的内容。

sentences.en: That's concise.
sentences.zh: 那很简洁。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, this was not what I was planning for.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这不是我计划中的情况。

sentences.en: I think I had told my editors that morning there was no chance this would be resolved today.
sentences.zh: 我想那天早上我告诉过我的编辑，今天不可能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: I mean, in the courtroom, you had dozens and dozens of people who have been listening to testimony.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在法庭里，有几十个人一直在听取证词。

sentences.en: They've watched Mark Harris for months say that he deserves to be a member of the United States Congress.
sentences.zh: 他们几个月来一直看着马克·哈里斯说他有资格成为美国国会议员。

sentences.en: And then he just gets up and suddenly calls for a new election.
sentences.zh: 然后他突然站起来呼吁进行新的选举。

sentences.en: It was one of those moments when you heard a lot of people gasp.
sentences.zh: 那是你听到很多人倒吸一口凉气的那种时刻之一。

sentences.en: It wasn't just one person gasping.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是一个人倒吸凉气。

sentences.en: A whole bunch of us gasped.
sentences.zh: 我们一大群人都倒吸了一口凉气。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you, sir.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，先生。

sentences.en: No further.
sentences.zh: 没有更多问题了。

sentences.en: Call this meeting adjourned.
sentences.zh: 宣布会议休会。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, Mark Harris leaves the room and a bunch of TV cameras chase after him.
sentences.zh: 所以，马克·哈里斯离开了房间，一群电视摄像机追着他跑。

sentences.en: Then this five-member elections board votes unanimously to have a new election.
sentences.zh: 然后这个五人选举委员会一致投票决定进行新的选举。

sentences.en: That was on Thursday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那是在周四下午。

sentences.en: And I spent the next few days asking Republicans the big question, will Mark Harris run again?
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，我一直在问共和党人一个大问题：马克·哈里斯还会参选吗？

sentences.en: And on Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 而在周二下午。

sentences.en: Breaking news out of North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 来自北卡罗来纳州的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Republican Mark Harris says he will not run in a new election for the state's ninth district.
sentences.zh: 共和党人马克·哈里斯表示，他不会参加该州第九选区的新选举。

sentences.en: In a statement, he said, quote, given my health situation, the need to regain full strength and the timing of this surgery the last week of March,
sentences.zh: 他在一份声明中说，引用如下：鉴于我的健康状况，需要恢复全部体力，以及三月最后一周手术的时间安排，

sentences.en: I've decided not to file in the new election for congressional district nine.
sentences.zh: 我决定不参加第九国会选区的新选举。

sentences.en: He cited his health and said he would not be a candidate next time around.
sentences.zh: 他提到了自己的健康状况，并表示下次他不会成为候选人。

sentences.en: So there will be a new election.
sentences.zh: 所以将会有一场新的选举。

sentences.en: But Mark Harris will not be a candidate.
sentences.zh: 但马克·哈里斯不会成为候选人。

sentences.en: There will be a new election, and Mark Harris will not be in it.
sentences.zh: 将会有一场新的选举，而马克·哈里斯不会参与其中。

sentences.en: So in the meantime, the people of the ninth district of North Carolina won't have any representation in Congress, and that ninth district seat will remain empty.
sentences.zh: 所以在此期间，北卡罗来纳州第九选区的民众在国会将没有任何代表，那个第九选区的席位将保持空缺。

sentences.en: Alan, what have we learned from what happened in the ninth district of North Carolina?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，我们从北卡罗来纳州第九选区发生的事情中学到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, we've gotten a really detailed playbook about how election fraud can happen in the United States.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们得到了一本关于选举欺诈如何在美国发生的非常详细的剧本。

sentences.en: We've seen how absentee ballots are prone to abuse.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到了缺席选票是如何容易被滥用的。

sentences.en: And we've also seen a real embarrassment for Republicans in North Carolina and around the country.
sentences.zh: 我们也看到了北卡罗来纳州和全国共和党人的真正尴尬。

sentences.en: For years and years, Republicans have been sounding an alarm about the possibility of fraud at the ballot box.
sentences.zh: 多年来，共和党人一直在对投票箱可能出现的欺诈行为敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And for years and years, Democrats have been saying that Republicans were blowing up those worries.
sentences.zh: 而多年来，民主党人一直说共和党人在夸大这些担忧。

sentences.en: They were using fraud as a pretext to be able to discriminate.
sentences.zh: 他们利用欺诈作为借口来实施歧视。

sentences.en: And now in North Carolina, we have the biggest case of election fraud in memory, and it was bankrolled by a Republican campaign.
sentences.zh: 而现在在北卡罗来纳州，我们有了记忆中最严重的选举欺诈案件，而且是由共和党竞选团队资助的。

sentences.en: This was not voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 这不是选民欺诈。

sentences.en: This was election fraud.
sentences.zh: 这是选举欺诈。

sentences.en: A lot of egg on a lot of people's faces.
sentences.zh: 很多人都丢脸了。

sentences.en: Election fraud, not voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 选举欺诈，而不是选民欺诈。

sentences.en: And why does that distinction matter, do you think, Alan?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，你认为这种区别为什么很重要？

sentences.en: Republican politicians have spent years trying to argue that individual voters are the problem when it comes to fraud in elections.
sentences.zh: 共和党政客们花了多年时间试图争辩说，当涉及到选举欺诈时，个人选民才是问题所在。

sentences.en: What happened in North Carolina had nothing to do with individual voters.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州发生的事情与个人选民无关。

sentences.en: It was all about a coordinated effort to sway an election.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一场旨在左右选举的协调行动。

sentences.en: It was a Republican campaign paying for illegal conduct.
sentences.zh: 这是一个共和党竞选团队为非法行为买单。

sentences.en: That was the problem.
sentences.zh: 那才是问题所在。

sentences.en: Now, there's a new interest in ensuring the sanctity of American elections.
sentences.zh: 现在，人们对确保美国选举的神圣性产生了新的兴趣。

sentences.en: I've been focused for decades on protecting the integrity of elections.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我一直专注于保护选举的公正性。

sentences.en: So, Alan, on Tuesday morning, Republican Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell gave a speech.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾伦，周二早上，共和党参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔发表了演讲。

sentences.en: Now, Madam President, for years and years, every Republican who dared to call for common-sense safeguards for Americans' ballots was demonized by Democrats and their allies.
sentences.zh: 现在，议长女士，多年来，每一位敢于呼吁为美国人的选票提供常识性保障的共和党人，都被民主党及其盟友妖魔化了。

sentences.en: In which he declared that what happened in North Carolina is, in his telling, evidence that there is, quote, very real voter fraud happening in the country.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中宣称，北卡罗来纳州发生的事情，用他的话来说，证明了该国正在发生“非常真实的选民欺诈”。

sentences.en: Now that an incident of very real voter fraud has become national news, these longstanding Democratic talking points have been really quiet.
sentences.zh: 现在，一起非常真实的选民欺诈事件已经成为全国新闻，这些长期以来的民主党谈话要点真的安静下来了。

sentences.en: Haven't heard much lately from Democrats about how fraud never happened.
sentences.zh: 最近没怎么听到民主党人说欺诈从未发生过。

sentences.en: And he said that Democrats should look at this and realize that the Republican argument is right, that there is a problem, and that they should accept it.
sentences.zh: 他说民主党人应该看看这个，并意识到共和党的论点是正确的，确实存在问题，他们应该接受这一点。

sentences.en: So, I'd like to welcome my friends on the left to their new realization.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想欢迎我在左翼的朋友们接受他们的新认识。

sentences.en: They've just discovered that this subject really matters.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚发现这个话题真的很重要。

sentences.en: The lesson of the 9th District is not that fraud happens.
sentences.zh: 第九选区的教训不是欺诈会发生。

sentences.en: The lesson of the 9th District is how fraud happens.
sentences.zh: 第九选区的教训是欺诈是如何发生的。

sentences.en: Maybe the Senate Majority Leader doesn't know the difference between election fraud and voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 也许参议院多数党领袖不知道选举欺诈和选民欺诈之间的区别。

sentences.en: But a lot of people on Tuesday thought he was just conflating the two and trying to misdirect and muddy the waters and make people think that what Republicans had been warning about for years happened.
sentences.zh: 但周二很多人认为他只是在混淆两者，试图误导和搅浑水，让人们认为共和党多年来一直警告的事情发生了。

sentences.en: But it didn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: The Times reports that President Trump's former personal attorney, Michael Cohen,
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道，特朗普总统的前私人律师迈克尔·科恩，

sentences.en: will portray the president in deeply unflattering terms during his testimony today before Congress.
sentences.zh: 将在今天向国会作证时以极其负面的措辞描述总统。

sentences.en: Relying on documents and his personal experience, Cohen is expected to describe what he says is Trump's use of racist language, lies about his will, and potential criminal conduct,
sentences.zh: 依靠文件和他的个人经历，科恩预计将描述他所说的特朗普使用种族主义语言、关于遗嘱的谎言以及潜在的犯罪行为，

sentences.en: including payments of hush money to two women who say they had affairs with Trump.
sentences.zh: 包括向两名声称与特朗普有染的女性支付封口费。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday night, the House voted to overturn President Trump's declaration of a national emergency at the Mexican border,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，众议院投票推翻了特朗普总统在墨西哥边境宣布的国家紧急状态，

sentences.en: with 13 Republicans breaking ranks to side with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 有13名共和党人打破党派立场，站在了民主党一边。

sentences.en: The legislation, which seeks to block Trump from diverting money for his proposed border wall without congressional approval,
sentences.zh: 这项旨在阻止特朗普在未经国会批准的情况下为他提议的边境墙挪用资金的立法，

sentences.en: now heads to the Republican-controlled Senate, where it faces stiffer opposition.
sentences.zh: 现在提交给共和党控制的参议院，在那里它面临更强硬的反对。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, for the first time in five decades,
sentences.zh: 周二，五十年来的第一次，

sentences.en: Indian warplanes crossed into Pakistan and conducted airstrikes against a jihadi militant camp in the northern part of the country.
sentences.zh: 印度战机越过边境进入巴基斯坦，对该国北部的一个圣战武装营地进行了空袭。

sentences.en: The airstrikes were a reprisal for a suicide attack carried out by the jihadis two weeks ago against India's military, which killed 40 soldiers.
sentences.zh: 这次空袭是为了报复两周前圣战分子对印度军队发动的自杀式袭击，那次袭击造成40名士兵死亡。

sentences.en: Information regarding the location of training camps in Pakistan and in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir has been provided to Pakistan from time to time.
sentences.zh: 有关巴基斯坦和巴基斯坦占领的查谟和克什米尔地区训练营位置的信息，已不时提供给巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: Pakistan, however, denies their existence.
sentences.zh: 然而，巴基斯坦否认它们的存在。

sentences.en: According to India's foreign secretary, Pakistan has been repeatedly warned about the jihadis, but has done nothing to crack down on them.
sentences.zh: 据印度外交秘书称，巴基斯坦一再收到关于这些圣战分子的警告，但并未采取任何行动进行打击。

sentences.en: The existence of such massive training facilities, capable of training hundreds of jihadis, could not have functioned without the knowledge of the Pakistan authorities.
sentences.zh: 这种拥有训练数百名圣战分子能力的大型训练设施的存在，不可能在巴基斯坦当局不知情的情况下运作。

sentences.en: The airstrikes immediately raised the possibility of war between two nuclear-armed rivals.
sentences.zh: 空袭立即引发了两个拥核竞争对手之间爆发战争的可能性。

sentences.en: But the Times reports that leaders of both India and Pakistan have deliberately given themselves options for de-escalating the situation.
sentences.zh: 但《泰晤士报》报道称，印度和巴基斯坦的领导人都刻意为自己留出了缓和局势的选择。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》上，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一觉睡到天亮的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为喝醉而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，它们需要什么样的光照？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 它们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 它们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 它们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
